title: CREATE_ACCOUNT: the new account appears as a CREATED entry and as a CAP-0067 transfer event
pattern: Two CREATE_ACCOUNT operations in one transaction, each funding a new account with 1000 XLM. Each operation's meta holds the funder's state and update and the new account as a created entry, and, since CAP-0067, a transfer event of native XLM from the funder to the new account. Readers that count transfer events as payments double-count account funding; readers that only watch payment operations miss it.

hazards.placement: CreateAccountOp emits a CAP-0067 transfer event of native XLM to the new account

facts.says: The new account alice is created with 10000000000 stroops.
A transfer event moves the same 10000000000 stroops of native XLM from root to alice.
